newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Joe White yet to meet on Ridley offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Joe White yet to meet on Ridley offer.

text.p: Takeover target Joe White Maltings Ltd hopes to convene a directors' meeting for Wednesday to discuss the scrip and cash offer from stockfeed firm Ridley Corp, Joe White Maltings said on Tuesday.
"We have not met yet," Joe White Maltings managing director John Hannaford told Reuters. "We hope to have it (the meeting) tomorrow," he added.
Ridley said on Monday it was prepared to lift its offer for the Melbourne-based malt production company, to a friendly offer of an effective A$5.90 per share.
The offer consists of two Ridley shares, A$2.36 cash and continued entitlement to a 14 cent per share dividend for Joe White Malting shareholders.
Ridley had previously offered A$5.44 per share, an offer rejected by Joe White.
Ridley's share price closed at A$1.73 on Tuesday, four cents higher than Monday's close.
